title: Ceramics Studio Membership
source_quote: The monthly membership fee provides access to the Arts Center's Ceramics Studio, use of communal tools and glazes, and access to our kiln.
evidence_sentence: The Ceramics Studio membership includes access to a kiln and the community anagama firing opportunity.
evidence_quote: The Dragon Fire Anagama Kiln was built in the early 1990s by Stephen Powell, Mack Jackson, and a group of Centre College Students. This Japanese-style cave kiln is fueled by wood
summary: Membership in the communal Ceramics Studio (up to 15 experienced potters) includes access to a kiln and opportunity to participate in the wood-fired anagama firing. Requires completion of two 6–7 week wheel-throwing or hand-building classes at the Art Center, or submission of portfolio and experience description.
cost_text: Monthly membership fee; firing fees assessed based on weight of pieces
how_to_join: Download membership application on the ceramics studio page
